questions.q: What does scanning a registered source actually do that registration alone does not?
options: It deletes the old metadata and starts over
It connects to the source, captures technical metadata, extracts schema, and applies classifications
It assigns the source a sensitivity label automatically
It creates a new collection for the source
questions.explain: Registration only gives Purview the source's address. Scanning is the step that connects, captures metadata like names and file size, extracts schema, and applies classifications.

questions.q: In the 'Scope your scan' step, what does a 'partially selected' folder mean?
options: The folder has been corrupted and can't be scanned
The folder is selected for a dictionary rule only
Some, but not all, of the folder's child items are selected
The folder will be scanned twice
questions.explain: A folder shows as partially selected when some but not all of its child folders or files are individually selected — distinct from fully selected or not selected.

questions.q: What does an L2 scan level extract that an L1 scan does not?
options: Data sampling and classification
Nothing — L1 and L2 are identical
Schema for structured file types and database tables
Sensitivity labels
questions.explain: L1 extracts only basic metadata (name, size, fully qualified name). L2 adds schema extraction for structured file types and database tables, but still doesn't sample data or apply classification — that's L3.

questions.q: What does the default 'Auto detect' scan level setting do?
options: It applies the highest scan level available for that particular data source
It always applies Level-1, the lowest setting
It disables classification entirely
It requires you to manually pick a level on every single scan run
questions.explain: Auto detect resolves to whatever is the highest scan level the source currently supports — for Azure SQL Database, for example, that currently resolves to Level-3.

questions.q: After a scan's Last run status shows Completed, when do the scanned assets actually become searchable in the catalog?
options: Immediately, the instant the status changes to Completed
Only after ingestion finishes processing the scan's output, which can take a bit longer
Only after a second, separate scan is run
They are never searchable until manually published
questions.explain: A Completed scan status means the scan itself finished, but assets only become discoverable once the ingestion process has finished loading that scan's output into the Data Map.
